730163.Description: [On Play] Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Add 1 blue [ALYSION] trait card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.

730164.Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Trash the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.

730165.Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If your opponent has no Digimon with digivolution cards, this Digimon unsuspends.

730166.Description:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If you have a blue Digimon with the [ALYSION] trait, gain 1 memory.
[Main] By suspending this Tamer, 1 of your blue Digimon with the [ALYSION] trait gains [Piercing] for the turn. (When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle while attacking, it checks security before the attack ends.)
730166.Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.

732616.Description:
[Blocker] (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[When Digivolving] Trash all digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon can't attack until their turn ends.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon with as many digivolution cards as this Digimon or fewer are deleted, if you have [Valner Dragnogh], trash their top security card.

732617.Description:
[Main] You may play 1 blue [Renamon] or [Valner Dragnogh from your hand without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[End of Your Turn] [Delay] (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect.)
• Choose 1 of your blue [ALYSION] trait Digimon and it attacks 1 of your opponent's Digimon with fewer digivolution cards than it. It can also attack your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with this effect.

732619.Description: [On Play] Trash the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
732619.Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Trash the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.

732622.Description: [When Digivolving] Trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
732622.Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has the [ALYSION] trait, it unsuspends.
